fusions.name: Shell Cracker
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 28 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Testing Bump
fusions.desc: You ram every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage and knocking them back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Denticle Mail
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Feeding Thickens
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
